scope: Roll-up of already accepted primary source-fidelity findings; no converter or real transcript is created.

requirements.requirement: The main body is Darwin's four questions. Footnotes3–6 quote Frederick Smith's interlined answers. Preserve those answers as Smith's historical voice, with exact spans and uncertainty; neither discard them as generic editorial prose nor append them to Darwin's target.

requirements.case: Missing list and surviving original additions
requirements.requirement: Darwin's list key survives, the96-plant list itself is not transcribed, and footnote3 quotes Bunbury's additions. Distinguish each layer. Do not invent the missing list or treat every footnote as Darwin wording.

requirements.case: Partial literal prose inside a synopsis record
requirements.requirement: P1 is an editorial description of an untranscribed146-genus list. P2–3 are literal Gray comment/signature. Availability and authorship must be assigned by span, rather than classifying the whole record as either original letter or synopsis.

Agnes Haeckel reports Darwin approximately in German; the original Darwin letter is missing. This is evidence of a reported communication, not a verbatim Darwin response or license to back-translate an English target.

requirements.case: Different subjects in text and surviving images
requirements.requirement: Agassiz mentions a fish sketch, but the eight preserved enclosure images depict echinoderm structures. A shared source ID cannot turn the enclosure figures into the missing fish sketch.

requirements.case: Incoming memorandum and later recipient annotations
requirements.requirement: Blyth wrote the main memorandum. Darwin's annotations are a separate layer; the horn figure and sex-symbol/fraction notation require faithful source rendering. Do not infer Darwin authorship from later annotations.
The author states256 specimens, while the component counts94+95+69 sum to258. Preserve both as written, with a sidecar note; do not silently repair the target or prompt.

requirements.case: Uncertain reported quotation and open dating
requirements.requirement: The isolated journalistic quotation may misquote Darwin; no original letter is found. A before-death upper bound alone does not establish a late lower bound. Keep the voice/date hold.
